papers.what_it_is: A mathematical tutorial on variational quantum algorithms and QAOA for combinatorial optimization, with proofs that mean, Gibbs and CVaR functions are (pseudo-)guiding functions and a general circuit decomposition of QAOA, plus a short literature review.
